known_limitations: SpiderFoot fork: if its PostgreSQL restarts while a scan is starting, the scan stays STARTING; Harvest stops it at the 900 s SpiderFoot ceiling and records partial (reproduced twice). Costs one tool slot for up to 15 minutes; never reported as absence.
Interrupted SpiderFoot runs keep partial events in SpiderFoot (referenced by scan id); Harvest preserves no capture for them.
Maigret reports dead-proxy failures as 'unfinished: no conclusive native verdict', not 'errored'.
Execution reason after an operator cancel reads 'worker stopped; ...' (the job reason is correct).
Readiness checks GHunt credential presence only; validity is established by acquisition (invalid credentials surface as blocked/errored checks).
Several Maigret site definitions are nondeterministic (found/absent flips between consecutive runs: RussianFI, chaturbator.su, AllTheLyrics).
Live parity ran on f15bc8298117 (12-invocation ceiling spent); compared capture/normalization code is identical to the deployed build.
Search: Brave is rate-limited (open incident); Bing intermittently returns irrelevant results. DuckDuckGo carries the known-answer canary.
scripts/pin_release.py default --spiderfoot-frontend is 'sf-frontend'; this host's container is 'sf-frontend-ui' (pass the flag).
GHunt 2.3.4 cannot extract names or Maps photo/review detail (unsupported checks). Tool traffic and proxy spend are outside Harvest budgets.
